newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse slumps, buyers scarce.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse slumps, buyers scarce.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange All-Share Index slumped on Wednesday, with Ghana Commercial Bank GCB.GH the main faller in a market with very few buyers, its market report showed.
The Index fell 8.89 points or almost 2.5 percent to 349.16 points from Monday's 358.05 points.
Turnover was up on Monday's 86,700 shares, with 276,940 shares changing hands but offers outstripped bids by 3,092,840 to 1,884,420.
Ghana Commercial Bank (-80 cedis to 620 cedis), retail and trading group CFAO (-1 to 19) and Pioneer Aluminium Factory (-1 to 170) were the three fallers.
Fan Milk Limited (+10 to 400) and Accra Brewery Limited (+1 to 595) were the only risers.
